# Paths that cannot change whether the build or any test or gate passes, nor the version. (The root
# README.md and assets/logo.png ARE packed into every package, but a change to them alone needs no
# re-test: every publishing run packs fresh.) The single definition of "docs-only", used by:
#   - ci.yml "Plan · Detect changes": a push or PR touching ONLY these skips build and tests; any
#     other file counts as code.
#   - .github/scripts/Test-InertDiff.ps1: a queued PR (ff-validated) and a develop push or release cut
#     (find-tested-run) keep an earlier verdict when the tree differs only in these.
# Add a path only if NOTHING reads it during build, test, analysis or versioning. When unsure,
# leave it out: a missing entry costs a CI run, a wrong one skips tests on a real change.
#
# Syntax: globs relative to the repo root. `**` crosses directories, `*` does not.
docs/**
plans/**
ai-docs/**
.claude/**
assets/**
logo/**
.vscode/**
*.md
.github/*.md
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
LICENSE
